LUXEMBOURG - The European Finance Convention and the Euro Week hold 11th annual convention (To November 28). Main topics discussed are the euro's impact on the financial market; European payment systems and implication on bank profitability; an overview of the enlargement programme-benefits and disadvantages of the first wave of entries. Speakers include: European Commission President Santer; Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt; European Commissioners de Silguy, Monti, Wulf-Mathies, Bonino and van den Broek; MEP Karl Von Wogau; Bank of England Governor Eddie George; Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes; Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo de Rato; WTO Director General Renato Ruggiero; French Economy Minister Jean Arthuis; EIB President Brian Unwin.
